details:
> "VRChat provides the best creator revenue share out of any major UGC platform."

> https://x.com/VRChat/status/2051799442097864864

> https://hello.vrchat.com

I don't believe this statement is accurate, and I'm concerned it may not be compliant with EU advertising law. Specifically Directive 2005/29/EC (Unfair Commercial Practices) and Directive 2006/114/EC (Misleading and Comparative Advertising), as well as their national implementations (e.g. the German UWG, where unsubstantiated Spitzenstellungswerbung / superlative claims are routinely challenged).

Under EU law, an absolute superlative tied to a measurable, objective metric (a revenue share percentage) is not treated as puffery. It is a factual claim that must be verifiable, and the burden of proof lies with the advertiser. The phrasing "out of any major UGC platform" also functions as implicit comparative advertising, which triggers stricter requirements: the comparison must be objective, on material features, and not misleading.

"Major UGC platform" is an established category in the games and creator-tools industry. Industry sources consistently group platforms such as Minecraft / Minecraft Marketplace, Roblox, Fortnite, Dreams, Unity Asset Store, Unreal Engine Marketplace / Fab, and Steam Workshop under that umbrella. Several of these pay creators a higher share than VRChat's current ~50/50 split.

Given this, the claim that VRChat offers the best creator revenue share among any major UGC platform appears demonstrably false on its face, regardless of how favorably the category is interpreted.

I'm not trying to be adversarial here. I'm a creator who genuinely supports VRChat and wants the platform to do well. But I think the current wording exposes VRChat to avoidable risk in the EU (competitor Abmahnung, consumer-protection action, or regulator inquiry), and it's also the kind of claim that erodes trust with the creator community when it gets fact-checked.

I did send this text 5 weeks ago to `legal@vrchat.com` and didn't got any response so far. Neither did i see the wording change on the false advertisement in that time. So i hope here is a better place to get this changed.
title: "VRChat provides the best creator revenue share ..."
